reviewerRubric.contract: shortId returns the first eight characters only for exactly 64 lower-case hexadecimal characters and [invalid-id] otherwise
reviewerRubric.callers: the forwarder abbreviates configured roomId and pubkey through shortId before startup logging
reviewerRubric.privacy: the invalid marker must be constant and must not echo any attacker-controlled prefix
reviewerRubric.tests: replace permissive short-input expectations and cover empty, short, long, upper-case, non-hex, and Unicode inputs
reviewerRubric.guard: retain the log-redaction scan and forwarder startup assertion so direct full identifier logging remains rejected
reviewerRubric.compatibility: valid canonical Nostr identifiers keep their existing eight-character display while malformed configuration becomes visibly invalid

requiredEvidence.token: never returns more than it was given
